title: Runtime artifact
responsibility: Presents recorded test result contents only after a verified read, keeping missing or unreadable evidence explicit.

inputs.name: RuntimeArtifact.cell
inputs.description: Required result cell with capture and optional read. Missing capture means Not recorded; null media means bytes not stored. Only read.verified allows details.

inputs.name: RuntimeArtifact.label
inputs.description: Required accessible name for the artifact group when a stored capture exists.

inputs.name: RuntimeArtifact.lost
inputs.description: Whether reading failed instead of still pending. True makes absent reads unverified rather than loading.

inputs.name: RuntimeArtifact.refusal
inputs.description: Optional backend refusal, preferred over the read problem and generic hash-check failure message.

inputs.name: RuntimeArtifact.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier passed to case rendering, enabling callable rows scoped to that function.

outputs.name: RuntimeArtifact
outputs.description: Verified cases plus expandable assertions, steps, traces and other facts. Unstated assertions remain unknown. Raw JSON renders only while expanded; non-JSON recorded text is shown. Each formatted text value is capped at 12,000 characters with a shortened marker. No capture, missing bytes, pending read and failed verification have distinct messages.
